body:
I can confirm the issue with the MRP. It only happens on the first load of the project, then when `.godot` is properly generated, the error doesn't happen.

It's reproducible in 4.3-stable with this error:
```
ERROR: res://some_my_res.tres:6 - Parse Error: 
   at: load (scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:717)
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://some_my_res.tres. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
   at: _load (core/io/resource_loader.cpp:283)
```

And in 4.4-rc (cc7a951140fbdf9b1173dd3f301f9b256f749284) with this error:
```
ERROR: res://some_my_res.tres:6 - Parse Error: .
   at: _printerr (./scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:39)
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://some_my_res.tres. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
   at: _load (./core/io/resource_loader.cpp:335)
ERROR: res://some_my_res.tres:6 - Parse Error: .
   at: _printerr (./scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:39)
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://some_my_res.tres. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
   at: _load (./core/io/resource_loader.cpp:335)
```

I was working on an MRP for a new issue I was about to submit, but remembering what I read here because the error is so similar to mine. I wanted to double check if my MRP had a similar issue as this. It turns out it does.

I decided to test the MRP for this issue on  4.4.stable, this is what I discovered:
- The error does appear on the first load and appears to go away on reload
- The error hides itself in these situations
   1. The resource script `my_res.gd` is not opened in the script tab
   2. You open the resource file `some_my_res.tres` before you open `my_res.gd`
      - If you open `my_res.gd` on the script tab before opening `some_my_res.tres` the error appears again
   3. You have the packed scene `my_scene.tscn` opened in any capacity
   4.  ~~When a scene that doesn't reference any of the previously made resources is opened, it will randomly have 0-4 errors~~

update: iv is a separate issue entirely:  #104593

More details about how strange the error hides itself in a separate issue as that's not what this issue is about: #104588
